pointOnlyMeaning: Names/points support identity only. They are neither boundary contours nor geographic fit controls, and not every listed place is an urban quarter.
incomingSourceRules: Raw PDF originals remain local; selected map/native-vector panels and short factual/paraphrased semantics only in any eventual public packet.
Classify actual fine named quarter contours separately from strategic groups, action areas, urban character/landcover classes, cadastral units and statistical aggregation.
For an incoming source schema, record source-unit identity and version before any aliasing, splitting or grouping.
Observed contour and estimated world placement are separate claims; fit to actual roads/geographic features, never quarter label points.
Compare incoming candidates to both existing geometries before any count/admission; preserve alternatives and source-specific exclusions.
